topic: Auto/cab/bus drivers: why a yearly eye check matters

youtube.title: Drivers: blurry signs at night? Read this 🚕👀 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Auto, cab or bus driver? Blurry sign boards at night are a warning.
ஓட்டுநர்களுக்கு: வருடம் ஒரு முறை கண் பரிசோதனை அவசியம்!

• Vision often changes slowly, so drivers may not notice it getting worse.
• Driving depends heavily on your eyes; small blur can slow your reaction.
• Long hours, dust and AC air can dry the eyes and cause blurry, tired vision.
• Get an eye test every year, and keep windscreen and glasses clean.
• Take a short break every 2 hours on long drives.
• See an eye specialist urgently for sudden blur, double vision or loss of side vision.

gmb.text: For auto, cab and bus drivers, good vision is part of road safety. Vision often changes slowly, so many drivers do not notice that sign boards look blurry or that headlights at night feel blinding. Long hours, dust and air conditioning can also dry the eyes and make vision tired and blurry. We suggest an eye test every year, a clean windscreen and clean glasses, and a short break every two hours on long drives. See an eye specialist urgently if you get sudden blur, double vision or lose side vision. Our home eye test in Chennai is ₹100 for the whole family. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
